Use case: style-transfer. Asset: full-screen 16:9 Unity dungeon room WALLS painting, all three passages CLOSED. Image1 is the PRIMARY EDIT TARGET AND EXACT CAMERA/FLOOR GEOMETRY/INK STYLE authority, act1 installed room. Image2 is the old act content reference ONLY: its camera, floor geometry, skinny detailed ink treatment are REJECTED. Image3 installed Warrior and image4 user original drawing are supporting ink simplification references. Output one complete room, same full canvas framing as image1, no characters, no objects, no UI, no text.
MANDATORY GEOMETRY: Copy image1's floor slab seam geometry, eye level, view cone and room depth EXACTLY. Do not lower the rear floor line or flatten the floor. Rear wall/floor contact at center x50%, y61.5% of canvas measured downward; rear usable floor begins there. Central tile perspective converges near x50%, y48%. Near sides contact around x19%,y70% and x81%,y70%; foreground floor slab perspective matches image1. Same small room volume and the same camera, not a broad flat arena or endless corridor. Keep open unobstructed floor.
STYLE: image1's large designed solid black masses in recessed side walls and upper vault, chunky selective ink contours, clean large stone forms, very few intentional cracks. No small speckled black marks, many chips, triangular faceting, rendering or texture noise. Blacks are large connected planes, not just thicker outlines. Keep walls quiet to support interactive props.
ARCHITECTURE: Change the WALL ARCHITECTURE while retaining exact room projection. Do not copy all image1 pillars or just recolor it. Closed front wall occupies center x42-58%, with side wall panels around x15-26% and x74-85% available for optional passages. Wall/floor contacts and perspective stay unchanged.
Act2 is a cold abandoned sanctuary. Large flat blue-gray wall slabs and broad recessed black side panels. Replace act1's freestanding column rhythm with thick simple wall buttresses at the outside sides and a broad intact back-wall lintel; no repeated skinny columns. Two small cold cyan torch flames near x35%,x65%, restrained cool highlights. Only 2-3 broad simple ice pendants near upper edges, not strings of tiny icicles or icy cracks across floor. Floor has same slab geometry as image1 with cool muted gray-blue local color. Deep broad black side recesses MUST match image1's graphic weight.
